description: Implementation of BufferNULL class methods for null renderer in ANGLE project, handling buffer data operations such as setData, setSubData, copySubData, mapping, and index range retrieval.

classes.name: BufferNULL
classes.description: Class implementing buffer operations for null renderer in ANGLE.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, updating memory allocation and copying data if provided.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data at a specified offset.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer into this buffer at specified offsets.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the entire buffer for access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer, indicating access is finished.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Computes the index range for drawing based on buffer data.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data.
